what: Kyoto booking-site quote test, 14 Nov 2026. Same hotels, one night, 2 adults, US$, cheapest available room shown on Booking.com search results, quoted 14 Nov 2026.
whyTheseMonths: April and August chosen from the official Kyoto all-hotel monthly report (April about 1.8x August), not from the booking data itself.

pairs: The Royal Park Hotel Iconic Kyoto
Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Sanjo PREMIER
The Gate Hotel Kyoto Takasegawa by Hulic
The Chapter Kyoto, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel by Marriott

caveats: Only hotels that appeared in both the April and August first-page lists (first 20 of 50 five-star, first 20 of 122/163 four-star) were matched, so n is small and not a random sample.
April quoted about 5 months ahead, August about 9 months ahead; longer lead usually means lower August prices, which would push the ratio up.
Cheapest available room, one Tuesday per month; a sold-out or near-sold-out date inflates a quote (Chapter Kyoto 4.2x).
